verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official Agentic Toolbox CLI that installs locally and runs Qodo-managed skills, such as pre-PR review and retrieving applicable rules, alongside your coding agent (qodo-docs-32, qodo-docs-44, qodo-docs-5, qodo-docs-7, qodo-probe-4). Community users separately report hands-on use of the Qodo Command CLI agent, including its rwx permission toggle and SWE-bench results (qodo-comm-6, qodo-comm-1, qodo-comm-2). Missing for 10: a detailed command reference and install/auth specifics in the evidence, and independent corroboration of the current Agentic Toolbox CLI (community reports concern the earlier Qodo Command)
